contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' ($6,544.68) on the p5 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Total Contributions Received $ $6,544.68 (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' printed on BOTH sheets, and equals its two page subtotals 724.00 (p2) + 5,820.68 (p3)
contributions.detail: TWO Schedule A sheets, 20 rows. Sheet 1 (p2, foliated 'Page 2', 15 rows, every printed row used): 50 + 50 + 20 + 20 + 50 + 20 + 69 + 25 + 40 + 50 + 100 + 100 + 30 + 50 + 50 = 724.00 = that sheet's printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 724.00'. Sheet 2 (p3, foliated 'Page 3', 5 rows): 200.00 + 1,658.15 + 50.00 + 500.00 + 3,412.53 = 5,820.68 = its printed subtotal. 724.00 + 5,820.68 = 6,544.68 exactly = the printed Total Contributions Received = Box B. The 1,658.15 IN-KIND row and the 3,412.53 candidate LOAN row are both inside that anchor and are therefore published as contribution rows. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints $17,166.06 and is CUMULATIVE - never summed as an increment and never differenced against another filing. The ladder closes on the page: Box A $0.00 + Box B 6,544.68 = Box F 6,544.68, minus Box D 6,544.68 = the printed close $0.00.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' ($6,544.68) on the p5 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 6,544.68' AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made $ $6,544.68'
expenditures.detail: The 13 Schedule B rows sum to 406.46 + 77.51 + 5.03 + 20.00 + 145.69 + 500.00 + 39.09 + 350.05 + 159.12 + 4,589.02 + 218.70 + 10.71 + 23.30 = 6,544.68 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Box D. Rows 14 and 15 of the printed grid are empty (crop-proved) and nothing is written below the last rule. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints $17,166.06 and is CUMULATIVE - never summed as an increment. Note that Box B and Box D carry the IDENTICAL figure on this filing and the balance closes at zero; that is the filer's own arithmetic, transcribed as printed and not adjudicated.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on the contribution side; not applicable on the expenditure side. Both conventions were tested against this document's own printed figures: the contribution side sums to 6,544.68 WITH the single in-kind row (Tactical Campaigns, 1,658.15, marked '(in-kind donation of services)' in the name cell) and to 4,886.53 without it, and 6,544.68 is what the sheet's subtotal, the Total Contributions Received line and Box B all print - so in-kind is inside the promoted anchor here. On the expenditure side no row is marked in-kind and the form prints no in-kind column, so both conventions give the same 6,544.68. NOTE this was tested from scratch on this filing (ADDENDUM G1) and NOT inherited: the same filer's other 2020 filing in this chunk (dd959f95) was tested independently.
itemized.escalation_note: No cell needed escalation: the filing is a born-digital typed fillable form, printed and scanned crisply, every figure is machine type, and both sides close to the cent against two printed footers each on the first reading. The nine geometry proof crops listed in the frames were rendered at 900 dpi.

itemized.notes: modern_boxAF, revision 'v. 4.20' (footer). 5 pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover ('Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates'), p2 SCHEDULE A sheet 1, p3 SCHEDULE A sheet 2, p4 SCHEDULE B, p5 SUMMARY PAGE (LAST, as ADDENDUM I3 describes for this variant, but located by its heading). Foliation is CONTINUOUS ACROSS THE WHOLE DOCUMENT here (cover 'Page 1', Schedule A sheets 'Page 2' and 'Page 3', Schedule B 'Page 4', Summary 'Page 5') - a different practice from the per-schedule foliation seen on the Ivie filing in this same chunk and cycle, and one more reason a page ordinal locates nothing without reading the header. Page-face candidate 'Brian Voeks' matches the channel label; page-face office reads 'Utah County Recorder', which agrees with index.csv's 'County Recorder'. Report type: '30 Days after the Primary Election' (single radio); amendment ticked 'No'; signature date and Date of Report both 'July 9, 2020' while the channel labels the filing '7/30/20' - the page face governs and both are recorded. REDACTION: only the signature block is blacked out by the county; every donor address is published in the clear and the reduction to city/state is applied by THIS transcription at read time (ADDENDUM I4's 'a filename is not evidence of redaction', from the other direction). Two properties of the contribution side worth naming: the filer books a 3,412.53 CANDIDATE LOAN as a contribution row, and his single IN-KIND gift (1,658.15) is inside Box B - both established from the ladder and the printed subtotals, not from the words. A third: one row is an 'Anonymous Donation' whose address cell repeats the same words, so its city/state are blank because the filer wrote no address. All 15 printed rows of Schedule A sheet 1 are used, which is why the report needed a second sheet for five more entries.
